relationship: New additive generation; no earlier file changed. The 7 unit-text roundtrip rows of ruby-feature-additions/v1 stay the string part of F02.roundtrips; this generation adds the schema/provenance part.
contract: unitsdb-ruby v2.2.15 specs: spec/unitsdb/<collection>_spec.rb and <entity>_spec.rb check from_yaml(raw).to_yaml with canon be_yaml_equivalent_to(raw); spec/unitsdb/database_spec.rb checks Database.from_db(dir).to_yaml against the combined collections. This producer runs the same calls with the same matcher and adds class-exact structural equality, per-field preservation and schema evaluation; any mismatch fails the row.

checks.database: Unitsdb::Database.from_db(dir).to_yaml vs combined collections: canon + strict
checks.collection: Unitsdb::<Collection>.from_yaml(raw).to_yaml vs raw: canon + strict, schema_version kept with class, record count, schema errors on output not on input, canonical JSON sha256 before/after, YAML byte sha256 before/after
checks.record: Unitsdb::<Entity>.from_yaml(record.to_yaml).to_yaml (canon + strict) and the record inside the collection output (strict); per-field preservation for every schema-declared field, every key the record carries and identifiers/references/quantity_references/equivalence_class/canonical_conversion/scale_reference; schema evaluation on input and entity output
checks.strict: recursive equality of parsed YAML including value class (1, '1' and 1.0 differ), with dropped/added keys, lengths and values listed by path; mapping key order is counted (key_order_paths) and does not fail a row
checks.schema: draft-06 subset evaluated: $ref, type, required, properties, items, enum, const, pattern, minimum; keywords not evaluated are listed per collection (format; allOf/if/then in prefixes)

producer.runtime: ruby 4.0.1 +PRISM x86_64-linux, TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, session-local bundle, four separate processes (two profiles x two runs), nice -n 19
producer.stderr: each run's stderr holds one line, 'fatal: not a git repository', from unitsml-ruby's gemspec (spec.files = `git ls-files -z`) because the 2ec9583 tree is a git-archive extraction; the producer records no revision through git (2ec9583 was resolved with git rev-parse in the source clone) and the loaded unitsml 0.6.14 code is that tree

acceptance: Ruby-generated results (WORK-PACKAGES.md:99 category 'accepted Ruby-generated results'): the unitsdb-ruby library's own roundtrip under its own spec matcher, two runs byte-equal per profile.
findings: Both profiles: 897 records in 7 collections (prefixes 33, dimensions 93, units 380, quantities 200, unit_systems 8, currencies 178, scales 5); every database, collection and record check passes; 0 roundtrip failures.

Canonical JSON (sorted keys) of every collection and of the whole database is identical before and after the roundtrip; the YAML bytes are not (to_yaml reorders mapping keys and drops the leading '# yaml-language-server: $schema=...' comment, which units.yaml and scales.yaml do not have).
unitsdb 2.2.15 has no Unitsdb::Currencies collection class; currencies roundtrip through Database (database row) and per record through Unitsdb::Currency; the collection row is not_applicable.

Records carry keys their schema does not declare (allowed: no additionalProperties false): units quantity_references (all 380), si_derived_bases (24), prefixed (13), root_units[].prefix_reference (43 in gem data, 42 in b0b4315); unit_systems short and acceptable (8 each); scales short and description (5 each). All of them roundtrip.

The gem 2.2.15 data and b0b4315 differ only in units.yaml, and only in record NISTu196 (gram-force): root_units kgf-from-gf replaced by canonical_conversion factor '0.00980665' to NISTu11. The record passes in both profiles.
limits: UnitsML XML roundtrip is out of scope (no criterion owner has named it).
Schema evaluation is a draft-06 subset; format and the prefixes allOf/if/then rule are listed as not evaluated.
No independent reference: verdicts are the Ruby library's own roundtrip at one head per profile, run twice.
